items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Because he had been in Brazil with Tony Bennett.

ctx.x: It was like heaven though, you know, because it was great for the kids, it was a great neighborhood for them to be in, and we just really enjoyed it for eleven years. Oh and all the Brazilians came there too because every time, at that time, when anybody was coming to New York from Brazil, all the musicians, they would come to our friend Don Payne’s house.
Because he had been in Brazil with Tony Bennett.

And they’d come to his house and he’d bring them over to our house, and we had several sessions with them playing in our dining room. And we met Antonio Carlos Jobim, we met Joao Gilberto, we met Carlos Lyra, Edu Lobo, and Astrud was married to Joao at the time, and they came over with their little child, and I mean we met all these people, it was great, just wonderful.
